oshimitsu_lead_line1: Oshimitsu! is a search tool made just for men's rhythmic gymnastics videos.
oshimitsu_lead_line2: Discover a side of men's rhythmic gymnastics you have never seen before!
oshimitsu_no_more_videos: * There are no more videos to show right now.
oshimitsu_hero_say_body: — filter by any of these and a routine plays right away. Start by tapping whichever one interests you.
oshimitsu_ways_title: How would you like to search?
oshimitsu_ways_lead: There are three ways in. The first two take you straight to a list of videos with one tap.
oshimitsu_ways_form_note: Pick Individual and you can add as many apparatus as you like.
oshimitsu_way_individual_description: One gymnast performs with an apparatus. Everyone brings something of their own
oshimitsu_way_group_description: Five gymnasts tumble in unison, with no apparatus. The showpiece of the sport
oshimitsu_way_stick_description: A slender stick handled at speed. Watch the hands
oshimitsu_way_ring_description: Pass through the ring, then spin it. Flexibility shows here
oshimitsu_way_rope_description: Jump the rope and swing it. The tempo is a joy to watch
oshimitsu_way_club_description: A pair of clubs in motion. Precision in every throw and catch
oshimitsu_recommended_lead: Not sure what to watch? Start here. The order changes every time you open the page.
oshimitsu_narrow_label: Narrow by player or team name
oshimitsu_empty_filter_title: There are no videos for this yet
oshimitsu_empty_filter_description: We add videos little by little. Try a different apparatus above, or pick another way below.
oshimitsu_empty_keyword_title: None of the videos shown match “{keyword}”
oshimitsu_empty_keyword_description: A family name or a school name on its own works too. You can also load more with “Show more” and search again.
